title: Country Draft
shortDescription: Choose countries. Draft people. Build your cabinet.
description: Five rounds. Choose one of three countries, then one of its people and a free job. Points appear only after seating. Build a cabinet worth up to 195.

title: GeoWordle
shortDescription: Guess the mystery country in 6 tries.
description: A mystery country is hidden. Each guess reveals how far away you are and which direction to head. Narrow it down and solve it in six tries.

title: Pinpoint
shortDescription: Five countries. Tap where they are.
description: Place a pin on a blank coastline map. Closer taps score more. Five countries, with the last round counting double.

title: Flag Quiz
shortDescription: 10 flags. Name the country or fail.
description: A flag appears with four options. Pick the right country. 10 rounds, no second chances.

title: Higher or Lower
description: Is the next country higher or lower? Ten calls on one stat, and a wrong call doesn't end it.

title: Stat Guesser
shortDescription: Guess five numbers about the world.
description: Slide the pin to your guess on a ruler with two well-known countries marked for scale. Five rounds, the last counts double.

title: Blind Pick
shortDescription: Six countries. Six stats. Beat the perfect board.
description: Six countries arrive one at a time. Put each on the stat where it ranks highest. Your score is the gap from the perfect assignment.

title: Speed Flags
shortDescription: 30 seconds. How many flags can you name?
description: 30 seconds on the clock. Name as many flags as you can. A wrong answer costs 3 seconds.
